schema.first_release: Unix seconds of the resource's first release.
schema.forum_thread: Absolute discussion-thread URL, or null when the resource has none.
schema.mentions_versions: Game versions mentioned in the description. A mention like 0.39 or 0.39.4 is stored as 0.39.
schema.requires: Other resource ids linked within 120 characters of require, requires, required, needed, dependency, needs, must have, or install also.
schema.requires_tagid: Parallel to requires. The tagid when that resource id is already in the catalog, otherwise null.
schema.resource_id: Public id from /resources/<slug>.<id>/. requires uses this same id. The trailing number in path (tagid/<versionId>/) is the repository version id and is only used to match older rows.
schema.screenshots: Absolute image URLs from the current description.

tag_vocabulary.map: Category Terrains, or map/terrain in the title, tag line, or category title.
tag_vocabulary.pack: pack, bundle, or collection in the title, tag line, or category title.

schema.tags: Auto keywords: brand:<name>, vehicle:<type>, map, pack.
schema.version: The mod's own version label, not the catalog schema version.
